claim: The tweezers must be installed, or the installation supervised, by qualified personnel; an unauthorised installation voids the warranty and may cause serious injury or damage. The shipping crate is large and heavy and must be handled with care.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 10 (PDF page 12). Also Tweez 305/310 System Installation Guide, 2021 (sha256 1f664a72..., byte-identical in the installed folder and the lab archive): printed page 3 (PDF page 7). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
